title: The number of moths caught by light traps is affected more by microhabitat than the type of UV lamp used in a grassland habitat
why: Catches of 2,257 moths of 161 species at three LED settings in Jena grassland (audit 64, which saw a record that names no species). A per-species table naming a Chloroclystis or Loxostege would serve the spectral_range_nm cells harvest-48 holds for those genera, under desk-screen point 9. Neither main nor the canon file holds it.
